title: org.openvpi.otter.inference.F0 Level 1 exports
description: Properties declared by an F0 analysis contribution: the audio format that a host must prepare and the supported knobs. The host reads these properties before any provider runs. The interface and level define the syntax, independent of the variant.

sampleRate.description: Input sample rate in hertz. The host resamples the audio to this rate; the module never resamples.

channelCount.description: Input channel count. The module averages input with more channels down to this count and rejects input with fewer channels.

interval.description: Time between adjacent output frames, in seconds.

maxSegmentDuration.description: Maximum duration of the audio accepted by one execution, in seconds. No limit applies if absent. The host slices the audio so that no segment exceeds it.

knobs.description: The knobs this module supports. The module ignores a caller-supplied value for a knob that is absent here.

knob.description: A continuous knob: the range of values that a caller may request, and the value used if the caller requests none.
